company.name: Rology
company.shortDescription: Rology is an AI-assisted On-demand Teleradiology Platform.
company.description: Rology is addressing the shortage issue by providing a platform that remotely and quickly matches radiologists with patients from hospitals based on availability and specialism. and boost radiologists' productivity with an AI-powered DICOM reader. As technology progresses, the use of radiology examinations such as CT and MRI has increased globally. While the number of studies expanded rapidly, the number of radiologists increased at a far slower rate, resulting in a severe and acute radiology shortage worldwide.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 2 disclosed grants total $100,000, representing 9.01% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,273,792 to $18,608,280, a 4.35x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 59 (-18 over 90 days) and market heat at 32 (-7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
